description.value: Kawakubo is a Japanese restaurant in downtown Revelstoke founded by chef Shinji Kawakubo, who trained for over a decade in Japan before relocating to this mountain community to open his own kitchen. The restaurant specializes in sushi, sake, and steak, and features traditional tatami rooms available for group bookings. Its location in downtown Revelstoke places it within easy reach of cyclists passing through this major Trans-Canada corridor town.
